_about: Corrections to the Codex ledgers that the laptop's review of the 92 positions (REVIEW_POSITIONS_laptop.md, 'Facts only the frames show', Oct 14) settled from the video frames or from the ledgers' own numbers. normalize_ledger.py applies them to its COPY of the ledger (the Recording_QA files are never edited) and records them in the copy's `corrections`; the converter puts each `note` in the notes of the positions of its `turns` (all of the game's positions when `turns` is null). An op that changes nothing is an error. `was` is what the ledger says now (an op is refused on a ledger that says something else).
